products.name: Vertuo Capsule Crystal Ornament
products.details: Shimmer-finish crystal, a chrome-tone top and green satin ribbon turn the everyday coffee pod into a keepsake.
products.take: For the coffee obsessive. If the pod shape means nothing to you, the collaboration is doing the selling.
products.availability: US and Canadian product listings. Check current stock and delivery at checkout; decorative crystal needs careful handling.

products.name: Gingerbread Figural Mug
products.hook: Your mug has its own coffee.
products.details: A 20oz ceramic gingerbread character with a candy-cane handle and its own miniature red Tims cup.
products.take: The most useful pick in this edit. Buy for the character; skip if novelty mugs already crowd your cupboard.
products.availability: TimShop Canada lists this as Coming Soon at our November 12 check. The link opens its product page, not an available checkout promise.

products.name: Glass Christmas Tree Cold Cup
products.hook: A tree for the iced-coffee loyalist.
products.details: Tree-shaped glass with a star-topped lid, from the Peppermint Mocha-inspired holiday collection. Image shows the cup alongside other collection pieces.
products.take: A seasonal desk treat rather than an everyday travel cup. Worth it if you love the shape after the holiday hype fades.
products.availability: Available at select Canadian coffeehouses; local stock varies. The collection page and store locator help you find it—there is no verified online checkout for this cup here.

products.name: Bottle with Light String Ornament
products.details: A 4.5-inch plastic Coke bottle wrapped in a decorative light string, with a hanging loop. This is not a glass keepsake; no working-light feature is claimed.
products.take: Fun for the Coke loyalist or a maximalist tree. Skip if you want delicate glass décor.
products.availability: US Coca-Cola Store product listing. Canadian delivery is not confirmed; check destination eligibility before ordering.

products.name: Fry Box Embroidered Ornament
products.details: Four inches tall, with embroidered fabric, plush filling and a ribbon loop. It can hang on a bag after the holidays, too.
products.take: The best inside-joke gift here. Buy for the friend who gets it, rather than trying to impress everyone.
products.availability: Sold through Smilemakers, a McDonald’s approved merchandise vendor—not the drive-thru. Confirm ordering and delivery eligibility, especially for Canada.
